SELECT , IFNULL(agg.total_give_amount, 0) AS total_give_amount, IFNULL(agg.total_receive_amount, 0) AS total_receive_amount, IFNULL(agg.total_receive_amount, 0) - IFNULL(agg.total_give_amount, 0) AS net_amount, GREATEST(IFNULL(agg.total_receive_amount, 0) - IFNULL(agg.total_give_amount, 0), 0) AS pending_return_amount, ( SELECT r.pay_time FROM gift_record_info_t r WHERE (r.giver_person_id = p.id OR r.receiver_person_id = p.id) AND r.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY r.pay_time IS NULL, r.pay_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS latest_record_time, ( SELECT r.direction FROM gift_record_info_t r WHERE (r.giver_person_id = p.id OR r.receiver_person_id = p.id) AND r.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY r.pay_time IS NULL, r.pay_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS latest_direction FROM gift_person_info_t p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pr.person_id, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.direction IN ('GIVE', 'RETURN') THEN IFNULL(pr.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_give_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN pr.direction = 'RECEIVE' THEN IFNULL(pr.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_receive_amount FROM ( SELECT p_agg.id AS person_id, r.direction, r.amount FROM gift_person_info_t p_agg INNER JOIN gift_record_info_t r ON (r.giver_person_id = p_agg.id OR r.receiver_person_id = p_agg.id) AND r.is_delete = 0 WHERE p_agg.is_delete = 0 ) pr GROUP BY pr.person_id ) agg ON agg.person_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.operate_time DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT p.relation_type FROM gift_person_info_t p WHERE p.is_delete = 0 AND p.relation_type IS NOT NULL AND p.relation_type != ''
AND (p.org_id = #{orgId} OR p.user_id = #{userId})
AND p.user_id = #{userId}
AND p.relation_type NOT IN ( SELECT o.relation_code FROM gift_person_relation_option_t o WHERE o.user_id = 0 AND o.option_type = 'SYSTEM' AND o.is_delete = 0 AND o.relation_code IS NOT NULL )

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.relation_type, ''), 'OTHER') AS relation_type, COUNT(1) AS count FROM gift_person_info_t p WHERE p.is_delete = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.relation_type, ''), 'OTHER') ORDER BY count DESC
